echo (AE): Client asks: 30d POC, data must remain in EU+CA, no US/APAC subprocessors. Can we?

jamal (SE): Yes if we: pin routing to eu+ca, disable telemetry, and accept BYO-KMS for CA.

maria (Presales): I'll prepare two quotes: hosted pinned endpoints (fast) and small Dedicated with peering. Include BYO-KMS SKU. ETA 3h.

legal-bot: Subprocessor list: internal link. We can provide attestation and disable analytics for tenant. Backups may need ops change to stay in EU/CA.

echo (AE): Need one-page attestation + cost. Jamal, can you own attestation?

jamal (SE): On it  will draft and include config snippet and model residency note.
